LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.label: Nano-Aphrodisiac Addiction
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.description: The nervous system has grown accustomed to aphrodisiac nanofluid and keeps demanding its stimulation. When the supply stops, emptiness, irritability and an indistinct physical discomfort set in, while desire becomes harder to quiet. Obtaining more briefly suppresses the craving but deepens dependence; recovery requires staying away from it.
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.stages.1.label: Withdrawal
